caption: An X2.5 flare on 2026-04-24 (GOES start 08:01, peak 08:13, end 08:18 UTC) seen by GOES-18 XRS-B (top, 1-min flux; reference only, never a model input), SoLEXS (middle) and HEL1OS CZT1+CZT2 (bottom), both as the 20 s rates the model is built from. Chosen by a fixed rule: the highest-peak GOES flare of the test period with both instruments observing at least 90% of the interval from 30 min before its start to 30 min after its end.
